description: Read the Doctor’s posted parlays for one league (league, e.g. LGUE_nfl): 2-3 legs on different games, each graded by the real engine at B+ or better when posted, upcoming first with the newest regrade letter (currentGrade), then recent WON/LOST/PUSH results, plus the Doctor’s parlays record. Each item (bsd-doctor-parlays-v2) carries parlayType (lock = 2 legs, moonshot = 3), title, pitch, legCount, oddsAmerican (the combined parlay price) and netUnits once settled. An empty list means nothing cleared the bar today. Uses the app’s account permissions and paid-leg lock; a paid reader gets the legs to put the whole parlay on a slip. Action and version are fixed by this tool; do not supply them.
name: get_doctor_parlays
title: Read Doctor parlays
